'''Stage II Beckons''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed in the [[:Category:Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier. Killing one will grant the {{AdvancementLink|Pruner}}.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned after a [[Stage I Beckon]] evolves.
*Spawned by [[Stage IV Beckon|Stage IV Beckons]].
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Stage III Beckon]] is killed.
*Spawns as a result of a Colony-buffed [[Reinforcement System#Colony Buff|Reinforcement System]]:
**Spawned randomly upon the death of Parasites larger than 1 block.
**Spawned randomly on [[Residue]].
**Spawned on [[Infested Blocks]], created by other Beckons.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Stage II Beckons are Stationary Block Infesters and Defensive Support Parasites.

*Stage II Beckons are able to spawn [[Rupter|Rupters]], [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]], and [[Flying Carrier|Flying Carriers]] through the usage of [[Biomass]]. [[Stage II Beckon#Summoning and Mobs Value|More info below]].
*They're able to convert blocks, depending on their [[Hardness]], to their Infested Variant, these include Infested Dirt, Stone and Wood. The Infestation can spread in a 8 block radius (6 blocks along the Y-axis) with a 55 second minimum Infestation cooldown per block radius.
**The same Infested Blocks can generate Stage I Beckons, extending the range of the Infested Zone. There can be a maximum of 2 Beckons per Chunk.
* Stage II Beckons throw 4 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. The bombs inflict 6 damage each and place an effect cloud of stacking [[Viral]] and Poison.
* Stage II Beckons can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 5.5, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 2 Blocks range.
* Upon death, if at least one [[Colony]] is present in the dimension, Stage II Beckons will become [[Stage I Beckon|Stage I Beckons]].

=== ''Summoning'' ===
Stage II Beckons are capable of spawning various [[Mobs]], through the usage of [[Biomass]].

The summoning Ability is based on Points. Each Mob has a certain Points value. Spawned Parasites will either be sorted by Ground type or Air, Parasites categorized as Air type will be spawned instead of Grounded if the target is 3 blocks above the summoner.

'''Stage II Beckons have a total of 9 Points per summon and can summon 3 mobs before its cooldown of 12 seconds with a cap of 9 parasites active at once.'''

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Stage II Beckons, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
*Stage II Beckons will take damage over time and die if the current dimension is at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] or lower.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Like all Nexuses, Stage II Beckons do not despawn by default.
*Beckons are also known as '''VenkrolSII''' in the Mod Files.
*Contrary to popular belief, Beckons aren't Plants, despite looking like one. Biomass isn't Eggs, either. Eggs aren't present in any part of Parasites Life Cycle.
*Beckons use Biomass to clone [[Mobs]].
*Stage II Beckon's Model present roots. They use the roots to extract an unknown type of Energy from underground, which they use to infest blocks, clone Mobs and evolve.
